Common Hebrew phrases are divided below by everyday use, dining, travel, and popular slang. You can explore more through resources like [Teach Me Hebrew](https://www.teachmehebrew.com/100-basic-hebrew-phrases.html) and [Jewish Miami](https://jewishmiami.org/about/departments/missions/common_hebrew_words_and_phrases/).[[1]](https://www.teachmehebrew.com/100-basic-hebrew-phrases.html)[[2]](https://jewishmiami.org/about/departments/missions/common_hebrew_words_and_phrases/)

### Greetings & Courtesies

- **Shalom (שלום):** Hello, goodbye, or peace.
- **Boker tov (בוקר טוב):** Good morning.
- **Erev tov (ערב טוב):** Good evening.
- **Laila tov (לילה טוב):** Good night.
- **L'hitra'ot (להתראות):** See you soon or goodbye.
- **Ma nishma (מה נשמע):** What's up? or How are you?
- **Toda (תודה):** Thank you.
- **Toda raba (תודה רבה):** Thank you very much.
- **Bevakasha (בבקשה):** Please, you're welcome, or after you.
- **Slicha (סליחה):** Excuse me or I'm sorry.
- **Ken (כן) / Lo (לא):** Yes / No.[[1]](https://jewishmiami.org/about/departments/missions/common_hebrew_words_and_phrases/)[[2]](https://beelinguapp.com/blog/%22shalom-and-more-essential-hebrew-phrases%22)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wOMEoQ0DR84)

### Getting Around & Questions

- **Eifoh…? (איפה?):** Where is…?
- **Eifoh ha'sherutim? (איפה השירותים?):** Where is the bathroom?
- **Ma ha'sha'a? (מה השעה?):** What time is it?
- **Kama zeh oleh? (כמה זה עולה?):** How much does it cost?
- **Efshar bevakasha lekabel…? (אפשר בבקשה לקבל…):** Can I please have…?
- **Ani lo mevin / mevinah (אני לא מבין / מבינה):** I don't understand (male / female).[[1]](https://beelinguapp.com/blog/%22shalom-and-more-essential-hebrew-phrases%22)[[2]](https://jewishmiami.org/about/departments/missions/common_hebrew_words_and_phrases/)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8mz9GpZnCDw)[[4]](https://www.hebrewpod101.com/lesson/absolute-beginner-hebrew-for-every-day-1-top-25-hebrew-phrases)[[5]](https://dental-dvi.org.il/common-professional-hebrew-phrases/)

### Popular Slang

- **Yalla (יאללה):** Let's go, come on, or hurry up.
- **Sababa (סבבה):** Cool, great, or sure / no problem.
- **Achla (אחלה):** Great or awesome.
- **Achi (אחי):** Bro or my brother (informal term of friendship).
- **Ein matzav (אין מצב):** No way or impossible.[[1]](https://dental-dvi.org.il/common-professional-hebrew-phrases/)[[2]](https://www.touristisrael.com/hebrew-language-guide-for-tourists-in-israel/24759/)[[3]](https://www.masaisrael.org/hebrew-glossary/)
